#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int fun(const string& s) {
    int n = s.length();
    int p = 0;
    if (s[0] != '0') p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 2; i++) {
        if (s[i] == '_') {
            if (i == 0) p *= 9;
            else p *= 10;
        }
    }
    int p1 = 0;
    if (s[n - 1] == '_' && s[n - 2] == '_') {
        p1 = 4;
        if (n == 2) p1 = 3;
    } else if (s[n - 1] == '_') {
        if (s[n - 2] == '0' || s[n - 2] == '5' || s[n - 2] == '2' || s[n - 2] == '7') p1 = 1;
    } else if (s[n - 2] == '_') {
        if (s[n - 1] == '0') {
            p1 = 2;
            if (n == 2) p1 = 1;
        } else if (s[n - 1] == '5') {
            p1 = 2;
        }
    } else {
        int val = stoi(s.substr(n - 2));
        if (val % 25 == 0) p1 = 1;
    }
    int pro = p * p1;
    return pro;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int T = 1;
    while (T--) {
        string s;
        cin >> s;
        if (s.length() == 1) {
            if (s[0] == '0' || s[0] == '_' || s[0] == 'X') {
                cout << 1 << "\n";
            } else {
                cout << 0 << "\n";
            }
        } else {
            bool hasX = false;
            for (char c : s) {
                if (c == 'X') {
                    hasX = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!hasX) {
                cout << fun(s) << "\n";
            } else {
                long long sum = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
                    std::string ch = s;
                    for (int j = 0; j < s.length(); j++) {
                        if (ch[j] == 'X') {
                            ch[j] = '0' + i;
                        }
                    }
                    sum += fun(ch);
                }
                cout << sum << "\n";
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
